title: Worms World Party
statusNote: Plays: N-Gage and Two Tribes logos, title screen, main menu, Single Game Deck > Quick Game loads a match against the computer; moving, aiming, the weapons menu, firing and the pause menu all work.
notes: The title screen asks for key 5, and 5 is the select key in every menu. The right soft key goes back.
A title screen left alone starts a demo match; any key returns to the title.
Single Game Deck has Quick Game, Missions, Custom Game and Training. Game Options > Misc. Options > Key Layout shows what every key does.

A Bluetooth game is under Multiplayer on the main menu (Host Quick Game, Host Custom Game, Join Game), and each player picks a team first. It does not work on this site yet: the joining player's list of hosts stays empty. N-Gage Arena is no longer online.

multiplayer.menu: Multiplayer > Host Quick Game or Host Custom Game / Join Game, then pick a team
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chose Host Quick Game and a team and was told the team "is waiting for clients to connect"; the other chose Join Game and a team, and its Select Host list stayed empty under "is looking for hosts" for a minute and a half. Its phone finds the host's game and reads the host's team name from it, over and over, but the game never lists it, so nobody can join.

controls.source: The game's own Game Options > Misc. Options > Key Layout screen, which describes every key; moving, aiming, the weapons menu, firing, jumping and both soft keys were also tried in a Quick Game.

actions.rsk: Game menu in play; back in menus
actions.1: Change the bounce of thrown weapons
actions.2: Change the fuse time of thrown weapons
actions.3: Change how much is shown above each worm
actions.4: Show or hide the weapons menu
actions.5: Fire; hold to add power. Select in menus
actions.8: Jump upwards; twice quickly does a backflip
actions.9: Centre the camera on the active worm

notes: In the weapons menu the directions move the cursor and 5 picks the weapon.
